title: Health & Safety Officer
company: A leading company in Construction / Real Estate
description:
Tipo de contrato: Tempo indeterminado

Descrição:
Cargo Health & Safety Officer Indústria Construção / Imobiliário Número de vagas 1 Descrição da função Site Inspections & Audits: Daily walkdowns of the Right-of-Way (RoW), monitoring excavations, lifting operations, and heavy machinery to prevent incidents. Risk Management: Facilitating Job Safety Analyses (JSA) and enforcing the hierarchy of controls (elimination, substitution, engineering, administrative, PPE) for all field tasks Incident Investigation: Leading root-cause analysis (RCA) for any near-misses, spills, or injuries, and tracking corrective action close-outs. Environmental Compliance: Monitoring waste management, spill prevention, and environmental footprint tracking in alignment with international mandates

Requisitos:
Titulação mínima Bacharelato Experiência exigida 5 Anos Nacionalidade Angola Línguas Não definido Area funcional * Engenharia mecânica * Engenharia civil * Imobiliário e construção - Outros Competências * Engenharia civil * Segurança Industrial (HSE) Aptidões necessárias Industry Experience: Minimum 5+ years of relevant HSE experience, specifically within Water & Waste Water EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) Language Skills: Fluency in English is required; however, professional proficiency in Portuguese is highly desired by Angolan regulators and local Education & Certifications: A bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or Engineering. Mandatory international certifications include NEBOSH (National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health) or OSHA
